sn55.26:1.2: tena kho pana samayena anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn55.26:1.3: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
sn55.26:1.4: “ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vanda,
sn55.26:1.5: “anāthapiṇḍiko bhante, gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn55.26:1.6: so āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandatī”ti.
sn55.26:1.8: “sādhu kira bhante, āyasmā sāriputto yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
sn55.26:2.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho so puriso anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa paṭissutvā yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.26:3.1: “anāthapiṇḍiko bhante, gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn55.26:3.2: so āyasmato sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandati.
sn55.26:3.4: “sādhukira bhante, āyasmā sāriputto yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
sn55.26:4.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho āyasmā sāriputto anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
sn55.26:4.2: kacci te gahapati, khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti?
sn55.26:4.3: na me bhante, khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ. bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti, no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamo”ti.
sn55.26:5.1: yathārūpena ca kho gahapati, buddhe appasādena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te buddhe appasādo natthi.
sn55.26:5.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, buddhe aveccappasādo:
sn55.26:5.3: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.26:5.4: tañca pana te buddhe aveccappasādaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:6.1: yathārūpena kho gahapati, dhamme appasādena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te dhamme appasādo natthi
sn55.26:6.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, dhamme aveccappasādo:
sn55.26:6.4: tañca pana te dhamme aveccappasādaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:7.1: yathārūpena kho gahapati, saṅghe appasādena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te saṅghe appasādo natthi.
sn55.26:7.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, saṅghe aveccappasādo:
sn55.26:7.4: tañca pana te saṅghe aveccappasādaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:8.1: yathārūpena kho gahapati, dussīlyena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpaṃ te dussīlyaṃ natthi.
sn55.26:8.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, ariyakantāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
sn55.26:8.3: tāni ca pana te ariyakantāni sīlāni attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:9.1: yathārūpāya kho gahapati, micchādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpā te micchādiṭṭhi natthi.
sn55.26:9.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, sammādiṭṭhi.
sn55.26:9.3: tañca pana te sammādiṭṭhiṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:10.1: yathārūpena kho gahapati, micchāsaṅkappena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te micchāsaṅkappo natthi.
sn55.26:10.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, sammāsaṅkappo.
sn55.26:10.3: tañca pana te sammāsaṅkappaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:11.1: yathārūpāya kho gahapati, micchāvācāya samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpā te micchāvācā natthi.
sn55.26:11.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, sammāvācā.
sn55.26:11.3: tañca pana te sammāvācaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:12.1: yathārūpena kho gahapati, micchākammantena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te micchākammanto natthi.
sn55.26:12.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, sammākammanto.
sn55.26:12.3: tañca pana te sammākammantaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:13.1: yathārūpena kho gahapati, micchā ājīvena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te micchāājīvo natthi.
sn55.26:13.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, sammā ājīvo.
sn55.26:13.3: tañca pana te sammāājīvaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:14.1: yathārūpena kho gahapati, micchāvāyāmena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpo te micchāvāyāmo natthi.
sn55.26:14.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, sammāvāyāmo.
sn55.26:14.3: tañca pana te sammāvāyāmaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:15.1: yathārūpāya kho gahapati, micchāsatiyā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpā te micchāsati natthi.
sn55.26:15.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, sammāsati.
sn55.26:15.3: tañca pana te sammāsatiṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:16.1: yathārūpena kho gahapati, micchāsamādhinā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati tathārūpo te micchāsamādhi natthi.
sn55.26:16.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, sammāsamādhi.
sn55.26:16.3: tañca pana te sammāsamādhiṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:17.1: yathārūpena kho gahapati, micchāñāṇena samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpaṃ te micchāñāṇaṃ natthi.
sn55.26:17.2: atthi ca kho te gahapati, sammāñāṇaṃ.
sn55.26:17.3: tañca pana te sammāñāṇaṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyuṃ.
sn55.26:18.1: yathārūpāya kho gahapati, micchāvimuttiyā samannāgato assutavā puthujjano kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati, tathārūpā te micchāvimutti natthi.
sn55.26:18.2: atthi ca kho te, gahapati, sammāvimutti.
sn55.26:18.3: tañca pana te sammāvimuttiṃ attani samanupassato ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambheyyunti.
sn55.26:19.1: atha kho anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa ṭhānaso vedanā paṭippassambhiṃsu.
sn55.26:19.2: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āyasmantañca ānandaṃ sakeneva thālipākena parivisi.
sn55.26:19.3: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati, āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn55.26:19.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā sāriputto imāhi gāthāhi anumodi:
sn55.26:23.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkami.
sn55.26:24.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn55.26:24.2: “handa kuto nu tvaṃ ānanda, āgacchasi divādivassā”ti.
sn55.26:24.3: āyasmatā bhante, sāriputtena anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati iminā ca iminā ca ovādena ovaditoti.
sn55.26:24.5: mahāpañño ānanda, sāriputto, yatra hi nāma cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni dasahi ākārehi vibhajissatīti.
